description: This file defines the Address model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform, providing methods to add, edit, delete, and retrieve customer address data from the database.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: Model class for managing customer addresses within the Opencart platform.

methods.name: addAddress
methods.description: Creates a new address record in the database for a specified customer.

methods.name: editAddress
methods.description: Updates an existing address record for a customer.

methods.name: deleteAddresses
methods.description: Deletes address records for a customer, optionally a specific address.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific address of a customer.

methods.name: getAddresses
methods.description: Retrieves all addresses associated with a customer.

methods.name: getTotalAddresses
methods.description: Returns the total number of addresses for a customer.
